audit.whatIsWrong: The level-6 and first-item spikes are described without naming the abilities that create them.
audit.why: Supreme Display of Talent is a flat 120-second ultimate that detonates the element she took from terrain, knocking up and stunning. Audacity falls from 11s to 7s across ranks, which is what actually shortens her all-in cycle at first item.
audit.corrected: Level 6 = a 120s Supreme Display of Talent that needs one wall; First item = Audacity closer to 7s, so her gap-closer returns before your Q does.

audit.whatIsWrong: packet reports the page never names a single Qiyana ability, and it calls Comeuppance 'global' twice.
audit.why: Comeuppance has 2500 range, not global range — a player who believes otherwise will hold it for a cross-map execute that cannot happen. Qiyana's actual kit: Elemental Wrath (Q, flat 7s, 525 range) whose bonus effect depends on the element; Terrashape (W, flat 7s, 1100) which dashes to terrain and enchants the weapon; Audacity (E, 11/10/9/8/7s, 650) her only gap-closer; Supreme Display of Talent (R, flat 120s, 950) a projectile shockwave that detonates elements for a knockup and stun. The whole kit is terrain-gated, and terrain is also what Heroic Swing needs — the same walls arm both of you.
audit.corrected: Fight in the open lane, away from walls: with no terrain she has no element, no detonation and only a 650-range Audacity. Comeuppance reaches 2500 units, so use it on a chipped Qiyana leaving a fight, not as a map-wide snipe.

audit.why: Audacity at 11s rank 1 is the punishable cooldown; her Q and W are both flat 7s and are never the window.
audit.corrected: Step up in the 11 seconds after a spent Audacity; her Q and W come back too fast to wait on.
